description: WriteProtection restricts editing but does not encrypt the document for open-time password protection.
suggestion: Use OoxmlSaveOptions.Password or DocSaveOptions.Password when the article claims encryption.

description: MailMerge.Execute is used in a mustache/non-merge-fields context without MailMerge.UseNonMergeFields = true.
Manual Shape-based watermarking is used where Document.Watermark.SetText or SetImage is the dedicated API.
Signing the DOCX package does not carry that PKCS#7 signature into a later PDF save. The resulting PDF will not have a digital signature.
suggestion: Use PdfSaveOptions.DigitalSignatureDetails to embed a digital signature directly into the PDF: set options.DigitalSignatureDetails = new PdfDigitalSignatureDetails(CertificateHolder.Create(...), reason, location, DateTime.Now) and call doc.Save(path, options).

description: Removing blank pages via ExtractPages() plus page-range reconstruction is fragile and verbose. Aspose.Words provides a built-in dedicated method.
suggestion: Use the built-in doc.RemoveBlankPages() method: load the document, call doc.RemoveBlankPages(), then save. This is the recommended single-call approach.

description: Article context is about memory optimization for large documents, but LoadOptions.MemoryOptimization is not set. The explanation will be incorrect.
suggestion: Add loadOptions.MemoryOptimization = true; before passing LoadOptions to the Document constructor. Also consider demonstrating LoadOptions.TempFolder and SaveOptions.TempFolder for documents that are too large to process in RAM.

description: Interactive form fields (text inputs, checkboxes, dropdowns) are flattened when converting DOCX to PDF via SaveFormat.Pdf. The resulting PDF will not be fillable.
suggestion: Add a disclaimer that form fields lose interactivity in the PDF output, or use Aspose.PDF to create native PDF forms with AcroFields.

description: Comment.Text setter was removed in Aspose.Words v26.1.0. Code using comment.Text = "..." will not compile.
suggestion: Use comment.AppendChild(new Paragraph(doc)); comment.FirstParagraph.AppendChild(new Run(doc, text));

description: Article is about removing blank pages but does not use the built-in Document.RemoveBlankPages() method.
suggestion: Use doc.RemoveBlankPages() — the dedicated single-call API for removing blank pages.

description: Article claims to produce a digitally signed PDF but does not use PdfSaveOptions.DigitalSignatureDetails. Signing the DOCX and then saving as PDF does not embed a signature in the PDF.
suggestion: Use PdfSaveOptions { DigitalSignatureDetails = new PdfDigitalSignatureDetails(CertificateHolder.Create(...), reason, location, DateTime.Now) } and pass it to doc.Save().
